[[Image:andoran-icon.svg|thumb|right|125px|Andor [[:Category:Chapter art|chapter&nbsp;icon]]]]

The '''Royal Palace of [[Andor]]''' is located in the very center of [[Caemlyn]]. Like most of the [[Inner City]], it was originally built by [[Ogier]] stonemasons.{{ref/book|1|35}} It holds the Lion Throne within the Grand Hall, the Royal Apartments, and several courtyards and stables.

It also houses a number of reception rooms, including the [[Blue Reception Room]].

The Palace was heavily damaged during the fight between [[Rand]] and [[Rahvin]], with the use of [[balefire]].

The Palace was occupied and probably destroyed or heavily damaged when the [[Shadowspawn]] conquered [[Caemlyn]] {{ref/book|14|1}}.
